Chapter 909: Chapter 11: The Arrival of the Demon Abyss (Subscribe Please)_2

All the mysterious Jade Immortals who had infiltrated the cave mansion had, without exception, fallen to Lin Yuan’s hands.

After all, from the first time to now, the grand formation of Immortal City had only detected the fluctuations of someone sneaking in, without any sign of escape.

“So many Jade Immortals, and they all died inside Master Yun Zhenzi’s cave mansion.” The Hall Master of Flying Immortal Hall contemplated for a moment, “This Master Yun Zhenzi truly is unfathomable.”

Normally, a battle between top-ranked Jade Immortals would not only be devastating, but at the very least, cause a tremendous aftermath.

However, there was never any disturbance within Lin Yuan’s cave mansion; all the Jade Immortals who snuck in vanished without a trace, as if they had never appeared to begin with.

This sent a chill down the spine of the Flying Immortal Hall Master, who couldn’t reconcile these events with the usual gentle and amiable Lin Yuan.

“So, what do we do now?”

The Vice Hall Master spoke in a low voice.

“What to do?” The Flying Immortal Hall Master glanced over, “Master Yun Zhenzi is an honored guest of Cangwu Immortal City.”

Although Lin Yuan had demonstrated inscrutable strength, so far, he had not taken any action that was detrimental to Cangwu Immortal City.

As for those Jade Immortals who perished at Lin Yuan’s hands? Infiltrating the cave mansion area of Immortal City on their own volition, even if Lin Yuan didn’t kill them, Cangwu Immortal City would pursue them upon discovery.

Therefore.

The Hall Master of Flying Immortal Hall didn’t plan to do anything, nor did he have the curiosity to investigate further.

Every Jade Immortal has their own secret opportunities; investigating a Jade Immortal’s secret is tantamount to standing against them.

The Hall Master of Flying Immortal Hall had no intention of becoming Lin Yuan’s enemy.

…

Inside the cave mansion.

Lin Yuan tallied the spoils of war thoroughly.

“Adding it all up, it’s about seventy to eighty million top-grade Immortal Crystals.” Lin Yuan nodded to himself, quite satisfied.

The wealth of a normal Jade Immortal would be around a million top-grade Immortal Crystals. Seventy to eighty million top-grade Immortal Crystals accounted for a tremendous fortune.

Keep in mind that most Jade Immortals convert resources into their own strength, to be used on their physical body and soul. The excess treasures and Immortal Artifacts amounting to seventy to eighty million top-grade Immortal Crystals would definitely be considered wealthy.

“Hm?”

Lin Yuan’s gaze swept over the many spoils of war again and landed on a dagger. This dagger was entirely black, its power completely concealed, to the extent that even Lin Yuan did not sense any energy fluctuations.

To thoroughly eliminate the Jade Immortals who infiltrated, Lin Yuan usually suppressed them in an instant, then used the Abyss Demon’s memory contamination techniques to completely erase most of their life-saving measures.

To prevent these Jade Immortals from reviving elsewhere with resurrection methods, spreading everything that happened inside the mansion.

Over the past five or six hundred years, Lin Yuan had secretly killed many demons and was quite familiar with their memory contamination techniques.

Even if there were Jade Immortals who could resist such memory contamination, they would be like Yun Zhenzi, using methods such as severing karma and others, wishing to revive would take tens of thousands of years later.

By that time, Lin Yuan reckoned he would have already ended this traversal and returned to the Main Universe.

“This dagger…”

Before killing the beast-robed figure, Lin Yuan had also browsed through his memories, aware that the dagger was acquired by the beast-robed figure taking a great risk in killing the offspring of the lord of North Cold Immortal City.

In the memory of the beast-robed figure, the dagger was extremely sharp, able to cut through anything.

That’s why, after obtaining this dagger, the beast-robed figure believed his strength had increased significantly.

However, during the infiltration into Lin Yuan’s cave mansion, from beginning to end, the beast-robed figure didn’t even have the opportunity to see Lin Yuan before dying under the immense pressure of vast space and time.

There was no chance to utilize the dagger.

“Sharp?”

Lin Yuan held the dagger and lightly drew it across the skin on his left arm.

Suddenly.

A wound appeared, then quickly healed.

“Indeed sharp!”

Lin Yuan was slightly astonished. His current Taiyang Divine Spirit, although not as strong as his true body in terms of physical toughness, was still above the level of a Jade Immortal, given the scale of the world within his body.

The vast inner world, continuously nurturing world force, provided nourishment to the body and soul that was incomparable by any natural treasure.

Even so, the dagger cut through his skin and flesh with ease.

“A twelve-tier weapon?” Lin Yuan scrutinized the black dagger but was still somewhat unsure.

The dagger gave Lin Yuan a feeling that it wasn’t as simple as a twelve-tier weapon. Even if it were a twelve-tier weapon, without any power infused into it, relying solely on the weapon’s sharpness, it shouldn’t have been able to slice his skin so effortlessly.

At Lin Yuan’s level, the so-called twelfth-tier weapons mainly depend on who wields them.

In the hands of the strongest, a twelfth-tier weapon can shatter anything; however, in the hands of an ordinary Jade Immortal, it’s just so-so.

“Interesting.”

Lin Yuan dedicated a sliver of his consciousness to studying the black dagger, for with its keen edge, if utilized adeptly, it could become a significant aid to him.

…

Time slips by.

A hundred years pass by in the blink of an eye.

“The Seventh Realm of the Space-Time Rule?”

With furrowed brows and deep in thought, after a century of continuous comprehension and aided by various sources of immortal essence, Lin Yuan faintly felt that he was incredibly close to grasping the Seventh Realm of the Space-Time Rule.

He was just one step away from the threshold.

Moreover, many other pillar-level fusion rules also saw a significant improvement, with each reaching the pinnacle of the Seventh Realm.

“No rush, no rush, take it slowly.”

Lin Yuan collected his thoughts and slowed his contemplation of the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule.

…

“However, in the past hundred years…”

Lin Yuan looked up slightly, his mind flashing with the many major events that occurred over that century.

While Lin Yuan’s focus was mostly on solitary cultivation and sense comprehension, in his spare time, he still paid attention to the many major events happening in the Immortal Realm.

And in the past century, the thirty-three domains of the Immortal Realm have been turbulent to say the least; with a multitude of demons descending from the Demon Abyss, countless immortals have met their deaths at the hands of these fiends.

The war between immortals and demons had already been raging for decades.

Compared to the past battles, the cruelty of this war was beyond measure. In previous conflicts, Immortal Cities were impregnable fortresses that no amount of demons could breach.

However, in this war, within just few decades, three Immortal Cities were breached, and innumerable immortals were devoured by demons.

“The Ancestor of the Immortal Path is not intervening?”

Lin Yuan’s eyebrows knitted slightly as he looked again towards the irregular rift in the sky.

With Lin Yuan’s current perception of space and time, he could clearly sense the vast fluctuations of the Ancestor of the Immortal Path’s aura.

“Is it because he is in closed-door cultivation?”

Lin Yuan speculated in his heart, inevitably puzzled. For the Ancestor of the Immortal Path, all the immortals in the Immortal Realm are the foundation of the Immortal Cultivation System, and it shouldn’t be to the point of negligence unless he really cannot extricate himself.

“But it has nothing to do with me.”

After pondering for a while, Lin Yuan summoned Yun Zhenzi and ordered, “I’m going into closed-door cultivation soon. Unless it’s a matter of utmost urgency, do not disturb me.”

Lin Yuan had a premonition that he was just one step away from the Seventh Realm of the Space-Time Rule, and thus all his attention would be on comprehending the Space-Time Rule, utilizing the accumulated immortal essence of over a hundred years continuously during this period.

In order to comprehend the Seventh Realm of the Space-Time Rule as soon as possible, Lin Yuan even slowed down the development and refinement of the Martial Tao First Tier Chapter.

As for what happened in the outside world, unless it truly affected him, he would not concern himself with it.

“Yes.” Yun Zhenzi responded respectfully.

…

Cangwu Immortal City.

The most central hall.

All the top leaders and high-ranking officials of the Immortal City had gathered here.

The atmosphere in the hall was heavy, and the top-tier Jade Immortals fell silent.

“Alright, there’s no need for despair. It’s just a large group of demons converging towards our Cangwu Immortal City; it’s not like we can’t withstand them,” the Immortal City’s Lord said slowly.

Not long ago, Cangwu Immortal City received intelligence: about seventy percent of the demons within the Xuantian Immortal Domain were slowly converging towards the area where Cangwu Immortal City was located.

This was not auspicious as it was highly likely that these demons had set their sights on Cangwu Immortal City.

If this were the case, the city would face an unprecedentedly bitter struggle soon.

If it were any of the past wars between immortals and demons, the city’s top leaders and high-ranking officials wouldn’t be especially grave, but only a few decades into this war, three Immortal Cities had already fallen into the hands of demons.

Could Cangwu Immortal City become the fourth to fall?
